cot_history.reasoning_cot: Adapts bid based on opponent's highest previous bid and current supply-demand pressure. Bids aggressively when HP is low or supply is tight, otherwise conserves budget or bids slightly above competitors.

Eric and Alex bid high, often near or above my salary. I will bid aggressively, especially when my HP is low or supply is tight, aiming to slightly outbid their previous high bids while managing my budget for long-term survival against strong competitors.
Analyzes opponents' previous day bids to gauge aggression. If high, I bid higher, especially with low HP. If low, I conserve budget. Also adjusts for supply variation to optimize water acquisition.
